PR03: composable default layout regions

Add PlateLayoutRegions, an immutable bundle of already-bound default
presentation regions (canvas, toolbar, feature tools, inspector, canvas
status) plus the PlateRegionWidgetBuilder typedef, exported through the
public support barrel. Custom PlateLayout hosts can place, omit, or
reorder these regions and mix them with raw plugin outlets.

- PlateLayoutContext gains an optional regions parameter; the canvas
  compatibility alias remains for legacy custom layouts.
- PlateLayoutRegionHost is a package-internal mutable binding: stable
  composition references (controller, session, coordinator, registry)
  plus shell-viewable slots, owned by one committed composition
  generation under a lease. Successful generation replacement, controller
  replacement, and unmount retire the old host so retained builders throw
  StateError('Plate layout regions are retired.') and never render a
  retired registry.
- The default shell renders the same region builders as custom layouts;
  buildPlateDefaultLayoutRegions is the single shared factory. Region
  markers diagnose rendering the same single-logical-region twice per
  composition with a FlutterError, scoped to one live render (registration
  released on deactivate) and deferred to a post-frame callback so the
  check never aborts a build that already mounted focusable siblings.
- Specs document movable default regions and the Web Bridge build-time
  composition boundary.

Tests: new plate_layout_regions_test.dart (7 tests) plus layout and
public-boundary updates; shared test-support transition plugin.
Validation: focused 6-file suite 80/80, dart analyze EXIT=0,
just test-baseline and just test-flutter pass.
